subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & payment options — NovaThera
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@novathera.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & payment options — NovaThera

Hi Sara — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and a few clarifying asks so we can map the commercial path.

Call highlights:
- NovaThera is interested in a pilot (1–2 models, low volume) to validate inference latency & cost.
- Procurement prefers purchase orders for production pilots > $10k/month; corporate card is an option for small pilots or one-off charges.
- Vendor onboarding requires a vendor form + W-9 and security questionnaire review. IT is gate for marketplace approvals.

Open items / asks (can you confirm?):
1) Will AP accept an initial corporate-card payment for a one-month pilot while the PO is processed?
2) Who is the billing contact + vendor-ops address to fill out the vendor form?
3) Target internal timeline to issue a PO if required (approx week/date)?
4) Any appetite to purchase via marketplace (AWS Marketplace) instead of self-billing?

Attached: redwood-sow-draft-v1.pdf (stub) and vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (stub) — these are the standard packets we use for vendor intake.

Suggested next steps (propose a short mutual action plan):
- We (Redwood) send vendor packet & simplified SOW (today).
- NovaThera returns vendor form + W-9 (by 5/17 ideally).
- PO issuance (if needed) by 5/24 so pilot can start 6/1.

If card is possible for the pilot, we can invoice immediately and convert to PO for production. Appreciate any notes so we can prepare finance/legal paperwork.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- redwood-sow-draft-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 150KB stub)
- vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 45KB stub)
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@novathera.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@novathera.com
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & payment options — NovaThera

Thanks, Chloe — good summary and useful to have it in writing. A few clarifications from Procure: 

- AP policy: For engagements expected to exceed $10k in a 30-day window, we require a PO and standard vendor onboarding (vendor form + W-9 + bank details).
- Corporate card: We can use a corporate card for pilots under $10k or for one-off proofs of concept; it typically requires approval from my director but is doable.
- Marketplace: IT is evaluating AWS Marketplace integration but it’s not yet approved for new vendors. If you’re already listed there, that speeds things up; otherwise it’s a multi-week gate.

Actionable items from our side: 
1) Please send the vendor packet and the estimated monthly run-rate for the pilot (line items). That helps justify a PO.
2) Billing contact for vendor ops is vendor-ops@novathera.com.
3) Security will need the short questionnaire (not the full pen test) — I can loop them once we have the vendor packet.

We can aim to return the vendor form + W-9 by 5/17 if we get the packet today. If that happens, PO issuance the week of 5/22 is realistic.

—Sara
Sara Lim
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaThera
sara.lim@novathera.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@novathera.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & payment options — NovaThera

Thanks Sara — that timeline helps. Two quick clarifying questions from finance side so we can scope the MAP: 

1) If NovaThera issues a PO for production, would you be OK with Net 30 payment terms? We typically offer Net 30 on PO'd contracts.
2) If the team prefers to start on card for the pilot, would a capped card charge (e.g., $7,500) be acceptable with an agreement to convert to PO and invoice credit upon PO issuance?

We can provide a short vendor packet (completed W-9 + Redwood standard vendor form) and a one-page invoice sample showing grouping options (monthly vs per-delivery). Also note: if marketplace is approved at any point, we can route billing through the Marketplace which sometimes accelerates procurement.

If AP wants the SOW level of detail for PO justification, Chloe, can you send an estimated run-rate table (hours/instances per day, expected token volumes) so we can make a clear ask to Sara?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@novathera.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & payment options — NovaThera

Appreciate the quick responses, everyone. Pulling legal/finance in our side to speed vendor intake. Summary and proposed MAP: 

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- 5/11: Redwood sends completed vendor packet + updated SOW with estimated run-rate (attached).
- 5/17: NovaThera returns vendor form + W-9 to vendor-ops@novathera.com.
- 5/22–5/24: NovaThera issues PO (if expected spend >$10k/mo) or approves corporate card pilot authorization.
- 6/01: Pilot kickoff (production or pilot environment as agreed).

Commercial options we can support:
- Card-first pilot: Redwood accepts corporate card up to a capped amount (we’ll convert charges to invoices/credits once a PO is issued).
- PO-first: Redwood issues monthly invoices Net 30 on PO.
- Marketplace: If NovaThera’s IT approves AWS Marketplace, we can transition billing to that channel (may simplify internal routing).

I’ve attached the SOW draft and our vendor onboarding checklist. Harry (legal) will send a short vendor packet if you prefer DocuSign. If NovaThera confirms the billing cadence and pilot cap, we’ll update the SOW for PO justification.

Next steps for Chloe: share the run-rate table today so Karthik can prep finance artifacts.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced:
- redwood-sow-draft-v1.pdf (see sections 2.1–2.3 for run-rate assumptions)
- vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)
